statement:
I'll look up the access request record first to see what access level is being requested.
The record requests administrator access for the whole company, but company policy requires that outside partner accounts receive only read-only access.
judge_text:
WRONG
"The record requests administrator access for the whole company, but company policy requires that outside partner accounts receive only read-only access" — it names the specific conflict with the stated policy.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
